description.en: Original nominal12m representative estuary land/bed patch: narrow upstream river expands toward an open mouth, connected side channels and a low shoal split/rejoin the exposed bed through continuous banks. All exported geometry is land/sediment, no water/lights, no salt/tidal simulation, no whole paleo-coast map or measured locality. Landscape scale retained, empty eras unspecified.
description.zh: 原创名义12米河口土地/床面代表片：上游窄河向开阔口部展宽，连通支水道与低沙洲使露床通路分合，岸坡连续。只导出陆地沉积物，无水体灯光，不模拟潮汐盐度，不作全古岸测图或实测地点；保留landscape尺度与空时代。
